13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 13 satisfies the preferred position in full: (i) 13.1 grants the subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), with no "non-transferable", "revocable" or narrow internal-use-only restriction; (ii) 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and fully paid, including contractor support, and 14.3 confirms that licence covers Vendor Technology required to use Deliverables; (iii) 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor via an assignment permitted by Section 24 (24.1 allows consent-free assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor), and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. "Affiliate" is defined on standard control terms with no carve-outs. No licence-scope deviation requiring a redline.
